== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|Artur Belfry is an [[Imperial]] [[Naberius Clayborn|Witness]] from the [[Aurelian Heartlands]]. Serving in the role of Chronicler, he is responsible for observing, reading, and documenting the history of [[The Empire|the Empire]] before disseminating that information to the public. He works alongside his brother, [[Vorus]] Belfry, who serves as his bodyguard and [[Silent One]]. Artur is a physically massive individual, standing nearly seven feet tall with immense strength, though his profession involves scholarly recording rather than arena combat. Throughout his career, he has experienced a largely peaceful era, encountering only minor physical conflicts rather than full-scale battles. In addition to his official duties, he has produced confidential reports for the [[Blackwatch]].}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|Artur serves as a tutor and lecturer, having provided instruction to [[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]]. He functions as an [[Imperial]] [[Naberius Clayborn|Witness]] and Chronicler dedicated to reading and recording history.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|Artur Belfry served as a tutor and lecturer to [[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]]. Additionally, Artur is an individual recognized by [[Alsa Grayweather|Alsa]].}}

== Of Sea and Shadow ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|Artur Belfry serves as an [[Imperial]] [[Naberius Clayborn|Witness]] and a Chronicler tasked with reading and recording the history of [[The Empire|the Empire]]. In his role as a tutor, he provided lectures and teachings to [[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]] while possessing a copy of [[Sadesthenes’ From Rising Sun to Setting Moon]]. Although he is a person known to [[Alsa Grayweather|Alsa]], his duties also include writing confidential reports for the [[Blackwatch]].}}
